chunks: They said, 'We cannot find the master's goblet. Whoever comes up with it will be given a camel-load of grain; I vouch for it.'
ai.seo_question: What was the ransom offered for the king's goblet in the story of Joseph?
ai.summary: In this verse, the Egyptians demand the return of the king's drinking cup (Siniq), with Simeon (or Joseph, depending on the exegetical view) offering himself as surety for a camel-load of grain. This incident highlights the strategic use of divine wisdom (Hikmah) to fulfill the prophecy of Joseph's brothers bowing to him, while demonstrating the practical justice and negotiation skills of the Prophet.
